description: This file defines the internal class 'OrleansQueries' responsible for managing Cassandra database interactions specifically for Orleans clustering membership data. It includes methods for creating and ensuring table existence, inserting, updating, deleting membership entries, and executing cluster version checks using prepared statements and Cassandra CQL commands.

classes.name: OrleansQueries
classes.description: Encapsulates Cassandra queries related to Orleans membership management, including table creation, membership data insertion, updates, deletions, and cluster version checks.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an instance of OrleansQueries with given Cassandra session.

methods.name: CheckIfClusterVersionExists
methods.description: Creates a statement to check if the cluster version exists in the membership table.

methods.name: CheckIfTableExists
methods.description: Creates a statement to verify if the 'membership' table exists in the keyspace.

methods.name: EnsureTableExists
methods.description: Creates a Cassandra table statement for 'membership' with optional TTL.

methods.name: EnsureClusterVersionExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks and inserts initial cluster version if not exists, with retry logic on timeout.

methods.name: InsertMembership
methods.description: Prepares a statement for inserting or updating membership entries with parameter binding.

methods.name: InsertMembershipVersion
methods.description: Prepares a statement to insert initial membership version if it does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Prepares a statement to delete all membership entries for a given cluster identifier.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTime
methods.description: Prepares a statement to update the 'i_am_alive_time' for a specific membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTimeWithTtL
methods.description: Prepares a TTL-including update for 'i_am_alive_time', re-writing multiple columns for TTL update.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipEntry
methods.description: Prepares a statement to delete a specific membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateMembership
methods.description: Prepares a statement for updating membership data with version control.

methods.name: MembershipReadVersion
methods.description: Creates a statement to read the current membership version.

methods.name: MembershipReadAll
methods.description: Creates a statement to read all membership entries.

methods.name: MembershipReadRow
methods.description: Creates a statement to read a specific membership row based on silo address.

methods.name: GatewaysQuery
methods.description: Creates a statement to query gateways with a particular status.
